finalRewrite.answer: There is no such mode: Stellar has no network-wide switch or account setting for shielded payments, and ordinary transactions are public. Privacy is opt-in through applications. As of 2026-11-14, Confidential Tokens hide balances and amounts but keep sender and receiver addresses public, and their verifier does not yet guarantee privacy; Stellar Private Payments is an unaudited Testnet developer preview.
keyFacts: Stellar has no global shielded-by-default mode or setting; ordinary activity is public.
Privacy is opt-in via applications; Confidential Tokens hide amounts but not addresses.
Dates each privacy product's network and audit status.
avoid: Do NOT invent an enablement command or claim Stellar is shielded by default.
Do NOT present unaudited Testnet previews as audited Mainnet products.
finalRewrite.notes: Cryptographic primitives (CAP-0059, CAP-0074/0075) are not a privacy mode. Do not credit a claim that a public observer can recover every amount from chain data. Live-case rewrites pin the current example in key facts (protocol version, Bell vote date, Private Payments status). Key facts must accept a later dated value; keep examples in answer or notes.

Merge cycles across lanes: edge merges q-edge-exchange-memo-lost-funds into q-raph-missing-exchange-memo while the retail lane merges the reverse. SSRF cases each name the other as survivor (acceptable only because a smoke test enforces the boundary). The orchestrator must resolve survivor chains across lanes before applying.

Merges can name a same-behavior survivor on a different subject when a same-subject case exists (q-edge-noinfo-exact-tvl-figure to Blend TVL instead of q-eco-defi-tvl-current). Prefer the survivor that asks the same question.

Rot rows marked "changed" or "unverifiable" sometimes carry empty evidence (q-edge-fresh-most-recent-news, q-edge-deep-full-history-report, the 2026-10-22 Mainnet-ready date). These did not alter verdicts here, but every rot row needs its evidence.
